corrections: The original small system included only the boundary equality; positivity was checked subsequently.
Backtracking scales the three displacement coefficients; four affine weights obey w(beta)=(1-beta)e_B+beta*w, not beta*w.
The normalized quantity is the candidate map defect relative to the original late map defect, not a difference from one shared unspecified y.
The 70-digit KKT certificate applies only to the stored Gram, not to large-field integration errors or a physical solution error bound.
Lecture coefficients use indices 1,2,3 whereas code uses 0,1,2; the active facet is translated explicitly.
